Faq.title: Questions and answers
Faq.description: How we grade used gear, and answers about ordering, custom tones, delivery, returns, repairs and selling us a guitar.
Faq.conditionIntro: Every used item gets one of these grades. Whatever the grade, the listing shows each flaw in the photos and says what it is, and you can ask on WhatsApp for more photos of anything.

grades.new: Never used, in its original packaging. For new gear such as strings and cables.
grades.mint: As new. No marks you can find, even up close.
grades.excellent: Lightly used. Faint marks you only see up close, and frets with little wear.
grades.very_good: Normal play wear: small dings, scratches or worn finish you can see at arm’s length. Nothing that affects how it plays.
grades.good: Clearly used: heavier wear such as buckle rash, chips or worn frets, or a past repair. Plays well.
grades.fair: Well worn, or with a non-original part. It works, and it’s priced for how it looks.

order.a: Tap Order on WhatsApp on the item’s page. WhatsApp opens with a message naming the item; we reply to confirm it’s still here and arrange delivery or collection.

hold.q: Can you hold an item for me?
hold.a: Yes, with a deposit. We mark it On hold on the site until you collect it or it’s delivered.

delivery.a: Yes, by courier anywhere in the UAE. You can also collect by appointment.

payment.a: In cash when you collect, cash on delivery through the courier, or by bank transfer.

returns.a: Yes. You have {returnDays} days from receiving an item to tell us about a problem and send it back in the condition you got it. The returns policy has the details.

several.q: Can I buy several items together?
several.a: Yes. Order one on WhatsApp and tell us what else you’d like; we put everything in one order with one delivery fee.

what.a: A preset for the NANOCORE, built for a song or sound you’re after and set for your guitar, pickups and tuning, and for what you play through.

how.q: How is a custom tone made?
how.a: You order with the tone details: the song, your guitar, pickups and tuning, and how you’ll use it. We build the tone and send you demo clips; you approve it or ask for a tweak. Up to {toneRounds} rounds of tweaks are included. Once you approve, we load it and ship.

after.q: Can I change a tone after delivery?
after.a: Tweaks happen before we ship, while you approve the demos. After delivery the tone stays as you approved it; another tone is a new order.

names.q: Can you name a tone after my favourite band?
names.a: We name tones by how they sound, never after a band. Tell us the band and song you’re after all the same: that stays between us.

quote.q: Do I pay anything before I agree to a repair?
quote.a: No. We check the instrument and send a quote to your ticket page first. Work starts only when you approve it.

time.q: How long does a repair take?
time.a: A setup usually takes a few days. Bigger jobs, or ones waiting for parts, take longer: your ticket page shows the expected date, and we message you if it changes.

track.q: How do I follow my repair?
track.a: You get a private link to your ticket page. Enter the last 4 digits of your phone number to see each step, the quote and photos.

decline.q: What if I decline the quote?
decline.a: We get the instrument ready for you to collect. A diagnosis fee may apply for the time spent checking it.

warranty.a: Yes, for {repairWarrantyDays} days from collection. If a problem we fixed comes back in that time, we fix it again at no charge.

collect.q: How long do I have to collect my instrument?
collect.a: Please collect it within {abandonDays} days of it being ready. After that it may be treated as abandoned under the repair terms.

sell.a: Yes: electric guitars, amps and pedals. Send the details and photos with the Sell us your guitar form, and we reply on WhatsApp with an offer.

sellPaid.q: How do you pay for a guitar you buy?
sellPaid.a: In cash at handover or by bank transfer, once we’ve checked it in person. We buy only instruments that are yours to sell, and may ask for proof of ownership.

visit.a: We’re online first and don’t publish our workshop’s address, so visits are by appointment. Message us on WhatsApp to arrange a time to see or try something.

language.a: Arabic and English. Message us in either.

About.title: About us
About.heading: Three players, one bench
About.description: {brand} is three players in the {location} selling gear, building custom tones and looking after guitars, online first.
About.intro: {brand} is three players in the {location}: one runs the business, one the bench and one the community. We sell gear we’d use ourselves, build tones for the music you play and look after your guitar.

gear.heading: Gear we’d use ourselves
gear.body:
We lead with the NANOCORE, a pocket amp-and-effects unit, sold with tones and a {warrantyMonths}-month warranty handled here in the {location}. Every unit is tested at our bench before it ships.

Used guitars are a side line. We play each one, set it up, photograph it flaws and all, and grade its condition honestly.

tones.heading: Tones built for your music
tones.body:
Tell us the song you’re chasing, your guitar, pickups and tuning, and what you play through. We build the tones, send you demo clips and tweak them until you approve, then load them before the device ships.

We name tones by how they sound, never after a band.

care.heading: Care at our bench
care.body: From fresh strings to a full setup, our starting prices are published. We check the guitar and quote first, and you follow every step on your own ticket page, with a WhatsApp message whenever it changes.

online.heading: Online first, by appointment
online.body: There’s no shop floor, and we don’t publish our workshop’s address. Orders start on WhatsApp; drop-off and collection are by appointment, and couriers cover the rest of the {location}.

Contact.title: Talk to us
Contact.description: Message us on WhatsApp or call. Online across the {location}; visits by appointment.
Contact.intro: WhatsApp is the quickest way to reach us, for orders, tones, repairs or a quick question. We answer in English or Arabic.
Contact.whatsappBody: Send a message, a photo of your guitar or a link to something you’ve seen. We reply as soon as we can.
Contact.callBody: Prefer to talk? Call the same number.
Contact.visitBody: We’re online first and don’t publish our workshop’s address. Message us to arrange a drop-off, a collection or a time to try a guitar, and we’ll send the location then.

terms.title: Terms of sale
terms.description: How ordering, prices, holds and payment work when you buy from us.
terms.intro: These terms cover buying from {brand}, an online-first shop in the {location}. By ordering from us you agree to them. They don’t affect your rights under UAE consumer protection law.

listings.heading: Listings and condition
listings.body:
Most of what we sell is used. Each listing gives a condition grade (see the condition guide in our questions and answers) and shows every flaw we know of in its photos and description. The photos are of the item itself, not a stock picture.

If you’d like more photos or a sound clip before buying, ask on WhatsApp.

prices.heading: Prices
prices.body:
Prices are in UAE dirhams (AED) and are the final price for the item. We aren’t registered for VAT yet; once we are, prices will include VAT and receipts will show it with our tax registration number (TRN).

Delivery is charged separately, as the delivery policy lists. If a price is wrong because of an obvious mistake, we’ll tell you before you pay, and you can cancel.

orders.heading: Orders
orders.body:
You order on WhatsApp: the Order button on each item opens a message naming it. Your order is confirmed when we reply to confirm the item is available and agree the price, delivery and payment with you. Until then, the item can still sell to someone else.

We sell to customers in the UAE only.

holds.heading: Holds and deposits
holds.body:
We can hold an item for you with a deposit until a date we agree. While it’s held, the site shows it as On hold, and the deposit counts towards the price.

If you change your mind before the hold ends, tell us and we’ll refund the deposit. If the hold ends and we can’t reach you, we may release the item and refund the deposit the way you paid it.

payment.heading: Payment
payment.body:
You can pay:

- in cash when you collect
- in cash on delivery, to the courier
- by bank transfer, to the account we send you on WhatsApp

We don’t take card payments online yet. You get a receipt for every order.

delivery.heading: Delivery and collection
delivery.body: We deliver across the UAE by courier, or you can collect by appointment. The delivery policy covers fees, times and what happens if something arrives damaged.

returns.heading: Returns
returns.body: You have {returnDays} days from receiving an item to tell us about a problem and ask to return it. The returns policy has the details.

liability.heading: Our responsibility
liability.body: We describe every item as honestly and accurately as we can, and stand behind that description. We aren’t responsible for wear the listing shows, or for damage after you receive the item. Nothing in these terms limits any responsibility the law doesn’t allow us to limit.

law.heading: Law and disputes
law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the United Arab Emirates. If something goes wrong, message us first: most problems are sorted out quickly that way.

changes.heading: Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these terms. The version on this page when you order is the one that applies to your order.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: What we collect when you order, book a repair or offer us a guitar, why, and your rights.
privacy.intro: {brand} collects as little about you as it can, and only to sell to you, repair your instrument or answer your messages. This policy explains what we keep, why, and your rights under the UAE’s personal data protection law.

collect.heading: What we collect
collect.body:
- Your name and mobile number, when you order, book a repair or offer us a guitar
- Your address, if we deliver to you or collect from you
- Details and photos of your instrument, for a repair or an offer
- Records of what you bought, the repairs we did and the payments you made
- Your messages to us on WhatsApp

We don’t ask for your email, your ID or your card details, and there are no accounts to sign up for.

use.heading: How we use it
use.body:
To answer you, arrange delivery or collection, carry out your repair and keep you updated, keep the records the law requires (such as receipts), and prevent fraud, for example by checking that a guitar offered to us isn’t stolen.

We never sell your details or use them for advertising.

whatsapp.heading: WhatsApp
whatsapp.body: We talk to customers on WhatsApp. When you give us your number on one of our forms, you agree that we can message you about that request, and we record when you agreed. WhatsApp is run by Meta, and its own privacy policy covers messages sent through it. Tell us any time if you’d like us to stop messaging you.

photos.heading: Photos
photos.body: Photos of your instrument for a repair or an offer are private: only we see them. The one exception is a repair photo we choose to show on your ticket page, which only someone with your link who passes the phone check can see. We remove location data from every photo uploaded to the site.

tickets.heading: Repair ticket pages
tickets.body: Each repair has a private link. It shows nothing about you until the last 4 digits of your phone number are entered, and it locks for a while after repeated wrong tries. If you think your link was shared, ask us and we’ll replace it.

cookies.heading: Cookies
cookies.body:
We use only the cookies the site needs to work: one remembers your language, and one remembers that you passed the phone check on a repair ticket page. There are no advertising or tracking cookies, and no analytics.

Our forms use Cloudflare Turnstile to block spam. It checks your browser without tracking you across other sites.

hosting.heading: Where your data is stored
hosting.body: The site and its data are hosted by service providers outside the UAE: Vercel runs the website, Neon the database and Cloudflare stores photos and blocks spam. They keep data for us under contract and may not use it for anything else.

keep.heading: How long we keep it
keep.body: Records of sales, repairs and payments are kept for as long as UAE law requires businesses to keep their records. Offers and repair bookings that didn’t go ahead are deleted once we no longer need them.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.body: You can ask for a copy of the details we hold about you, ask us to correct them, or ask us to delete them, except records the law requires us to keep. Message us on WhatsApp from the number we have for you, so we know it’s you.

returns.title: Returns
returns.description: How to return an item, what can be returned and how refunds work.
returns.intro: You can’t try a used instrument in a shop before buying it from us, so you get time to check it. This policy comes on top of your rights under UAE consumer protection law, not instead of them.

window.heading: {returnDays} days to check it
window.body: You have {returnDays} days from receiving an item to check it. If it isn’t as described, or you’re not happy with it, message us on WhatsApp within that time and we’ll arrange the return.

condition.heading: What can be returned
condition.body:
Items must come back in the condition you received them, with everything that came with them (case, tools, papers) and, for gear, in their packaging.

We can’t take back:

- strings, picks and other consumables once opened
- items that have been modified or worked on since you received them
- items damaged after you received them

costs.heading: Return costs
costs.body: If the item isn’t as described or arrived faulty, we pay for the return. If you’re returning it because you changed your mind, you pay for the return delivery, and the original delivery fee isn’t refunded.

refund.heading: Refunds
refund.body: Once the item is back and we’ve checked it, we refund you within {refundDays} days, the way you paid: in cash, or by bank transfer to an account in your name. If it comes back damaged, we show you photos and agree a deduction with you before refunding.

damaged.heading: Damaged in delivery
damaged.body: Check the box and the item when the courier delivers. If anything is damaged, photograph the item and the packaging, and message us within {damageHours} hours. We take it up with the courier, and you get a repair, a replacement or a full refund.

repairs.heading: Repairs
repairs.body: Repair work can’t be returned, but it is guaranteed: see the repair terms.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.description: Courier delivery across the UAE, collection by appointment, fees and times.
delivery.intro: We’re an online-first shop in the {location}. You can collect by appointment, or we send your order by courier anywhere in the UAE.

collection.heading: Collection by appointment
collection.body: Collection is free. We agree a time on WhatsApp and send you the location then: our workshop’s address isn’t published.

courier.heading: Courier delivery
courier.body: We use a courier that handles fragile items and takes cash on delivery. Guitars travel in a hard case or a box that supports the neck, insured for their price.

times.heading: Delivery times
times.body: We send orders within 2 working days of confirming them, and most arrive 1 to 3 working days after that. We send you the tracking details on WhatsApp.

fees.heading: Delivery fees
fees.body: The fee depends on the emirate and is added to your order. We confirm it before you pay. The current fees are:

cod.heading: Cash on delivery
cod.body: You can pay the courier in cash when the item arrives. Please have the exact amount ready if you can.

damage.heading: If something arrives damaged
damage.body: Check the item when it arrives. If anything is damaged, photograph it and the packaging, and message us within {damageHours} hours. The returns policy explains what happens next.

outside.heading: Outside the UAE
outside.body: We don’t ship outside the UAE at the moment.

repair-terms.title: Repair terms
repair-terms.description: Quotes, approval, diagnosis fees, collection and our guarantee on repair work.
repair-terms.intro: These terms apply to every repair. You accept them when you drop your instrument off, or when you approve a quote on your ticket page, and we record the time.

quotes.heading: Quotes and approval
quotes.body:
We check the instrument first and send a quote to your ticket page. Work starts only after you approve it: on the page, on WhatsApp or in person. If we find more to fix, we send a new quote and wait for your approval again.

A simple fixed-price job, such as a setup, can be approved when you drop the instrument off.

diagnosis.heading: Diagnosis fee
diagnosis.body: If you decline a quote, a diagnosis fee may apply for the time spent checking the instrument. We tell you the amount, and it’s due when you collect.

parts.heading: Parts and deposits
parts.body: Special-order parts may need a deposit before we order them. The deposit counts towards the repair.

intake.heading: When we receive your instrument
intake.body: We photograph it, note its condition and list what came with it (case, strap, tools), so we both have a record.

payment.heading: Payment
payment.body: You pay when you collect: in cash, by bank transfer, or in cash on delivery if we send it back by courier. Your ticket page shows what’s due.

collection.heading: Collecting your instrument
collection.body: We message you when it’s ready. Please collect it, or arrange delivery, within {abandonDays} days. After that, and once we’ve tried to reach you, it may be treated as abandoned, and we may sell it to cover what’s owed.

warranty.heading: Our guarantee
warranty.body:
We guarantee our work for {repairWarrantyDays} days from collection. If a problem we fixed comes back in that time, we fix it again at no charge.

The guarantee doesn’t cover wear from playing, accidents, changes in heat or humidity, or work by someone else.

liability.heading: Our responsibility
liability.body: We take care with every instrument while we have it. We aren’t responsible for faults it already had, for wear in parts we didn’t work on, or for old finishes and electronics that fail despite normal care. If a job puts them at risk, we tell you before we start.

courier.heading: Courier pickup and return
courier.body: If a courier carries your instrument, pack it in a hard case or a well-padded box. We arrange an insured courier and tell you the fee first.
